Cumulative transplant comparison plot

Source: R/plot_cumulative.R
plot_cumulative.Rd

Generates a year-over-year cumulative line chart for transplant activity, visually contrasting the current report year against the previous year.

Usage

plot_cumulative(cumulative_data, report_year = NULL, report_month = NULL)

Arguments

cumulative_data

A data frame (or tibble) returned by create_cumulative_df(), containing year, month, and cumsum columns.

report_year

(numeric) Calendar year of the current report (e.g. 2025).

report_month

(integer, 0–12) Final month shown for the year-to-date comparison.

Value

A ggplot object. Print it to display, or add layers / themes as needed.

Details

Key features

  • Vertical cut-off line at the reporting month.

  • Automatic labelling (via ggrepel) that places the higher value above the point, the lower below it, and nudges labels away from the y-axis when counts are near zero.

  • A faint “tail” segment shows how last year continued after the current cut-off, providing instant context on catch-up or lag.

Dependencies

Relies on ggplot2, dplyr, and ggrepel.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
cum_df <- create_cumulative_df(transplants,
                               report_year  = 2025,
                               report_month = 4)

plot_cumulative(cum_df,
                report_year  = 2025,
                report_month = 4)
} # }
